text:
zoe-l: Heads-up — candidate (Nora Velazquez) for Staff Data Eng hit an overnight flight cancellation, ETA now ~14:30 for a 09:00-17:00 loop. She asked if we can compress technical interviews and offer a hotel night if she needs to stay after the loop.

michael-b: Which interviews are must-be-in-person? I own the 15:00 system pairing; that one prefers onsite but can be shortened.

recruiter-bot: Profile: Nora V., international traveler, needs hotel assistance possible, dietary: pescatarian. Contact: nora.v@example.com.

zoe-l: Plan suggestion: 1) create backup Meet link for morning slots 2) compress morning + early afternoon into a 11:00-14:00 block, keep pairing at 15:00 but shorten to 40m, 3) reserve Quiet Pod J 13:30-17:30 for prep and resting, 4) pre-authorize one-night hotel if flights truly canceled, up to $180. @travel-bot can you pre-approve and frontdesk handle badge?

travel-bot: One-night hotel pre-approval set for candidate (Nora Velazquez) up to $180. Please have candidate forward booking receipts to travel@redwood.ai.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor prereg complete for "Nora Velazquez". Quiet Pod J reserved 13:30-17:30. Pescatarian boxed lunch on hold. Parking permit emailed.

facilities: Quiet Pod J will have an adjustable table and a power strip. We'll put out a small welcome sign and a water pitcher.

zoe-l: I'll send candidate + panel messages. Template to be posted here then sent.

(recruiter-bot posts queued candidate message):

"Hi Nora — sorry about the flight cancellation. We can compress your interviews into an 11:00-14:00 window and keep a shortened in-person pairing at 15:00 if you make it. Backup Meet link: https://meet.google.com/nora-backup. Quiet Pod J is reserved for you from 13:30-17:30 to rest and prep. If your flights are canceled we can book one night of hotel up to $180; please email receipts to travel@redwood.ai. Please confirm preference and whether you need hotel assistance"

michael-b: I can shorten pairing to 40m and be flexible. If she needs the hotel please coordinate with ops-shipping for any loaner device.

zoe-l: Sent to candidate at 07:40 — candidate replied: "Thanks, please compress and I'll let you know about hotel if my airline confirms cancellation."

frontdesk-bot: Badge printed and on-hold for "Nora Velazquez". Quiet Pod J setup complete.

zoe-l: Update: candidate arrived 14:10, used Quiet Pod J, we ran compressed block 11:00-14:00 remotely and did shortened 15:00 pairing onsite. Hotel not needed. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
